Title: Generally Available: Live Resize for Azure Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce the general availability of Live Resize for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks. Dynamically increase the storage capacity of your disks without causing any disruption to your applications. To reduce costs, you can begin by creating smaller disks and gradually increase their storage capacity without experiencing any downtime.

Get started with Live Resizing your Ultra and/or Pv2 disks here.
